messages:
marta (eng): RC build 2026.03.21-rc3 ready. artifacts: https://ci.internal.redwood/artifacts/rc3. draft notes PR: https://git.internal.redwood/releases/pulls/412
kevin (sheriff): can someone run a quick smoke on the canary image? I can own the promo window.
deploy-bot: CI: rc3 smoke passed. image gcr.redwood/rc3:2026-03-21 pushed. KV warm plan: 5m.
lia (pm): QA: green except flaky rerank test (non-blocker). added known-issue to release notes about embeddings fallback.
sam (release-czar): checklist: pin artifact, kv warm, canary, verify evals, promote. who pins?
marta (eng): pinned SHA a1b2c3d4. command used: ``/release pin a1b2c3d4``
kevin (sheriff): ack. ops, change window 14:00-14:30 UTC ok?
ops-oncall: change window ok. we'll monitor infra.
deploy-bot: KV warm starting for rc3 (5m).
kevin (sheriff): KV warm stable, running smoke: ``curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}'``
kevin (sheriff): smoke latencies look fine, no 5xx.
sam (release-czar): starting canary at 14:05 — 10% traffic. observability runbook: https://confluence/redwood/release-runbook
marta (eng): ``/deploy canary rc3 --percent 10``
deploy-bot: Canary started: 10% traffic. health checks passing.
kevin (sheriff): 10m in, no regressed errors; p50/p95 stable.
sam (release-czar): bump to 50% at 14:20 if metrics hold.
marta (eng): ``/deploy canary rc3 --percent 50``
deploy-bot: Canary updated: 50% traffic. health checks passing.
ops-oncall: infra healthy. no GPU/disk alerts.
kevin (sheriff): eval run e-2026-rc3: pass rate 98.7% vs baseline 98.9. minor drop but within tolerance.
sam (release-czar): small quality delta observed. options: promote with rollback guard, or hold. thoughts?
lia (pm): impact is low; prefer promote and notify support.
marta (eng): we have rollback plan. rollback target a1b2c3d3. command: ``/deploy rollback a1b2c3d3 --force``
kevin (sheriff): I'll sheriff for 30m post-promo. proceed if no objections.
deploy-bot: PRECHECK OK.
sam (release-czar): final call in 2m. lia/ops/kevin thumbs?
lia (pm): :thumbsup:
ops-oncall: :thumbsup:
kevin (sheriff): :thumbsup:
marta (eng): executing promote: ``/deploy promote rc3 --to prod --note "rc3: embeddings fallback known-issue"``
deploy-bot: Promotion started. staged roll: 10%->25%->50%->100%. est 12m.
kevin (sheriff): watching metrics. rollback if 5xx spike or error delta >0.5%.
deploy-bot: Stage 1 complete: 25% traffic. health passing.
deploy-bot: Stage 2 complete: 50% traffic. health passing.
ops-oncall: small uptick in tokenization time on shard (0.03s->0.05s) but within SLO. watching.
kevin (sheriff): metrics steady, no user-facing errors.
deploy-bot: Promotion complete: 100% traffic -> rc3 (a1b2c3d4).
sam (release-czar): nice work. publish notes and notify early-access customers.
marta (eng): release notes published, artifacts pinned, changelog pushed. post-deploy: monitor 30m, confirm rollback signals, close PR.
lia (pm): notifying support and updating board.
kevin (sheriff): ending sheriff at 14:55 UTC. all clear.
ops-oncall: will monitor for 1h. no action now.
sam (release-czar): closing thread. ping incident if anything. :tada:
